paragraphs.text: Faces first, hailed one by one. Hail: victory-fortune’s treasure — may I taste a wink the victory-shout’s nectar-sap. Hail: Rudra the One, Shiva the One, Great God, Great Lord — PArvatI’s lover, Sharva, first-born of all gods. Hail: brow-eyed sole badge of the three-worlds’ Lord. Hail: black-poison-throated — who drank the pain-struck world’s pain. Hail: three-powers-bodied self, hundred-pike-bright-handed. Hail: lotus-feet worship-worthy, aims ripened by will alone. Hail: other-world-body-bearer, streaming hundred beauties. Hail: single-topknotted, unwasting Ganges, rite-ash-seized. Hail: smeared with milk-sea moonlight shade. Hail: jewel-darling-snow-decked, risen from the Lord’s limb-touch. Hail: shelter like the undying cool-rayed digit. Hail: all-lordship-anointed, ever-damp with Ganges. Hail: whose low-limb-touch hallows cowherds. Hail, ever-present where love-drunk gather.

Then deeds hailed. Hail: who dupes the sillies, showing hot places at will. Hail: fit vessel of Gauri-embrace-fortune. Hail: greedy for love-gifts wet-and-wet with love-sap. Hail: gladdened by lovers’ word-dance, love-drunk and wild. Hail: BrahmA-and-first-gods’ might, rise and fall. Hail: whose edict world-lord-rows bear on heads. Hail: glory shown by self-seal set on all worlds. Hail: All-Lord, Great Lord, down to self-gift. Hail: matchless at three-worlds’ creation-wish-moment. Hail: with Goddess alone helping bear lordship’s load. Hail: who seized all three worlds with no step. Hail, unsatirized Lord-din, sung from childhood. Hail, inborn-high, past pity and the rest. Hail, Bhairava before whom dread great Death is wrought. Hail, unrivalled in world-burn’s raging work. Hail, hundred-weal praised name-chant. Hail, nectar-mine-sea spilt in play. Hail, whose wink-anger parches the world-burn dry. Hail, sole lamp of delusion-dark-blind breathing-folk. Hail, wakeful high Person of the sleeping world.

Then nearness and finale. Hail, life’s-life warbling in the body-mountain-bower. Hail, mountain-lord born of high gold-vein. Hail, unneared by pain-burnt sages and gods. Hail, seen by love-mad-folk mounted on every state. Hail, who leafs his own dependents, spreading Your wealth. Hail, whose one use is petting surrender-folk. Hail, sole bright deed of making, staying, unmaking. Hail, high feast of play-lotuses swaying in love’s headiness. Hail, victory’s vessel. Hail, birth-age-death-conqueror. Hail, world’s eldest. Hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail — Three-eyed.
